newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon raises Molex to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon raises Molex to buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers Inc said it raised its rating of Molex Inc on Wednesday to a buy from its prior rating of hold.
-- Analyst Thomas Hopkins changed the rating after the companies posted first quarter results after the market close on Tuesday.

-- "Particularly surprising was the ... revenue growth given the typically seasonally difficult September quarter," he said in a research report. He expects a 15 to 20 percent upside in a $43, 12-month price target.
-- "Results may indicate the end of the tech inventory back-up for Molex as well as a recovery in the co's Japanese consumer electronics end market," he said.
